note: First-load JS per route, uncompressed bytes, from .next/diagnostics/route-bundle-stats.json. Each budget is the route as measured (measured.routes) +2%, rounded up, and never raised by a ratchet: a line only comes down. The home page's line is also capped at the plan's W12 ceiling, 1,448,816 B (under abb0023's 1,448,843), whichever is lower. Every built route has its own line; a route without one (a page added since) gets defaultRouteBudget, which is the largest page's line after the home page, and gets its own line in the next ratchet. A budget moves only in a commit that says why: a change that goes over reports it in its PR instead of raising its own line. fontsSelfHosted is W2's switch. Checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs (npm run budget).
